customize.name: Fireside Merriment
customize.desc: A generous spread of hearty meat cuts combining Snezhnayan cured meats with Nod-Krai ham and sausage. Many older Nod-Krai locals like to savor it by the fire with a drink in hand.

customize.name: Delicious Fireside Merriment
customize.desc: A generous spread of hearty meat cuts. The thick raw cuts carry hints of pine and salt, the sausages give off a deep smoky fragrance, and the ham slices add a rich, savory touch. Bold and hearty, it's a feast any Nod-Krai local would give a thumbs-up to.

customize.name: Suspicious Fireside Merriment
customize.desc: A generous spread of hearty meat cuts. The dense fat, bitter and salty, hits the palate like a runaway carriage, leaving a lingering, oily trail down the throat... an intense assault few could endure.

customize.name: Raw Meat
customize.desc: A fresh chunk of meat. Handled properly, it can be used to make delicious food.

customize.name: Ham
customize.desc: Smoked leg meat. Even the thinnest slice is packed full of flavor.

customize.name: Sausage
customize.desc: Finely minced meat wrapped in a skin. A staple of every meat lover's daily diet.

customize.name: Pepper
customize.desc: Peppery. Cuts through oily flavors and excites the taste buds. Goes best on meat.
